banner.title: Privacy policy.
banner.lede: How YELI collects, uses and protects personal information when you visit yeli.com.au or send us an inquiry.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: YELI is a photography studio based in Sydney, Australia. In this policy, “YELI”, “we” and “us” refer to the studio. We handle personal information in line with the Australian Privacy Principles in the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth).

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: We only collect information you choose to give us, plus the basic technical data every website receives.
items: Inquiry details: when you use our contact form we collect your name, your partner's name, your email address, the date or season, the type of shoot, the location and your message.
Correspondence: anything you send us by email, phone or social media while we arrange or deliver a booking.
Technical data: like any website, our hosting provider automatically receives your IP address, browser type and the pages requested. We do not use this to identify you.

sections.heading: Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: This website does not use cookies, analytics or advertising trackers, and we do not build profiles of visitors.

sections.heading: How we use your information
items: To reply to your inquiry and discuss availability, packages and pricing.
To plan, deliver and follow up on a booking, including sending your photographs.
To keep records we are required to keep for tax and accounting purposes.
paragraphs: We use it only to respond to you and to do the work you book us for:
sections.closing: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information, and we do not send marketing emails unless you ask us to.

sections.heading: Services we rely on
paragraphs: Some information passes through trusted third-party services that help us run the website:
items: Netlify hosts this website and processes the technical data described above.
Web3Forms delivers the contact form to our inbox. Your inquiry details are processed by Web3Forms to send that email.
Pinterest hosts the portfolio images. When you view a gallery, your browser loads those images directly from Pinterest's servers, which receive your IP address.
Google Fonts provides the typefaces used on this site. Your browser requests them from Google, which receives your IP address.
sections.closing: These providers may store or process data outside Australia. Each handles data under its own privacy policy.

sections.heading: Photographs of you
paragraphs: Photographs from a booking belong to the agreement we make with you. We only share images of clients in our portfolio or on social media with their permission. If you appear in our portfolio and would like an image removed, email us and we will take it down.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep inquiries that don't lead to a booking for up to 12 months, then delete them. For bookings, we keep contact details and correspondence for as long as needed to deliver the work and meet our legal record-keeping obligations.

sections.heading: Keeping it secure
paragraphs: We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from misuse, loss and unauthorised access, and we limit access to the people who need it to work on your booking.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us for a copy of the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email us and we will respond within 30 days.

sections.heading: Questions or complaints
paragraphs: If you have a question or a concern about how we have handled your information, email us first and we will work with you to resolve it. If you are not satisfied with our response, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it last changed.
